description: This file contains unit tests for a mathematical expression parser and evaluator, specifically testing the functionality of the 'DoubleEvaluator' class for parsing and evaluating expressions in Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) and infix notation, as well as testing logical and mathematical operations, including functions and operators.

classes.name: ParserTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing parsing and evaluation of expressions in the DoubleEvaluator parser, including function parsing, boolean conversion, unary minus, and logical operations.

methods.name: testFunctionParameters
methods.description: Tests parsing of functions with parameters like log, max, and special cases.

methods.name: testBooleanConversion
methods.description: Tests conversion and evaluation of boolean expressions and operators.

methods.name: assertParseB
methods.description: Asserts that the evaluation of an expression matches the expected RPN string, and verifies infix conversion.

methods.name: getReplace
methods.description: Helper method to remove parentheses and spaces from a string.

methods.name: assertParse
methods.description: Evaluates an expression using DoubleEvaluator and asserts that its postfix output matches expected.

methods.name: getInfix
methods.description: Converts an RPN expression into an infix expression with parentheses, using a stack to process tokens.

methods.name: takesTwoParameters
methods.description: Checks if a token is a two-parameter operator.

methods.name: testUnaryMinus
methods.description: Tests parsing and evaluation of unary minus and exponentiation with negation.

methods.name: testBooleanNot2
methods.description: Tests boolean negation ('not') and logical negation operators.

methods.name: assertValue
methods.description: Asserts that expression evaluation yields a specific value and that the postfix matches expected.

methods.name: testRusEfi
methods.description: Tests parsing and evaluation of various logical and comparison expressions used in RusEfi environment.
